list.name: device
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT t.value FROM tags t JOIN runs r ON r.run_uuid = t.run_uuid JOIN experiments e ON e.experiment_id = r.experiment_id WHERE t.key = 'device' AND e.name = 'kernel-bench' AND r.lifecycle_stage = 'active' ORDER BY 1

list.name: branch
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT t.value FROM tags t JOIN runs r ON r.run_uuid = t.run_uuid JOIN experiments e ON e.experiment_id = r.experiment_id WHERE t.key = 'branch' AND e.name = 'kernel-bench' AND r.lifecycle_stage = 'active' ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Latency — fused kernel (median)
panels.description: x축은 커밋 시각. 커밋마다 CI 가 측정한 median latency.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT to_timestamp(m.timestamp / 1000.0) AS time,
       td.value || ' ' || replace(m.key, 'fused_ms/', '') AS series, m.value
FROM latest_metrics m
JOIN runs r ON r.run_uuid = m.run_uuid
JOIN experiments e ON e.experiment_id = r.experiment_id
JOIN tags td ON td.run_uuid = r.run_uuid AND td.key = 'device'
JOIN tags tb ON tb.run_uuid = r.run_uuid AND tb.key = 'branch'
WHERE e.name = 'kernel-bench' AND r.lifecycle_stage = 'active'
  AND td.value IN ($device) AND tb.value IN ($branch)
  AND m.timestamp BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()::bigint * 1000 AND $__unixEpochTo()::bigint * 1000
  AND m.key LIKE 'fused_ms/%'
ORDER BY 1

SELECT to_timestamp(m.timestamp / 1000.0) AS time,
       td.value || ' ' || replace(m.key, 'speedup/', '') AS series, m.value
FROM latest_metrics m
JOIN runs r ON r.run_uuid = m.run_uuid
JOIN experiments e ON e.experiment_id = r.experiment_id
JOIN tags td ON td.run_uuid = r.run_uuid AND td.key = 'device'
JOIN tags tb ON tb.run_uuid = r.run_uuid AND tb.key = 'branch'
WHERE e.name = 'kernel-bench' AND r.lifecycle_stage = 'active'
  AND td.value IN ($device) AND tb.value IN ($branch)
  AND m.timestamp BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()::bigint * 1000 AND $__unixEpochTo()::bigint * 1000
  AND m.key LIKE 'speedup/%'
ORDER BY 1

SELECT to_timestamp(m.timestamp / 1000.0) AS time,
       td.value || ' ' || replace(m.key, 'delta/', '') AS series, m.value
FROM latest_metrics m
JOIN runs r ON r.run_uuid = m.run_uuid
JOIN experiments e ON e.experiment_id = r.experiment_id
JOIN tags td ON td.run_uuid = r.run_uuid AND td.key = 'device'
JOIN tags tb ON tb.run_uuid = r.run_uuid AND tb.key = 'branch'
WHERE e.name = 'kernel-bench' AND r.lifecycle_stage = 'active'
  AND td.value IN ($device) AND tb.value IN ($branch)
  AND m.timestamp BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()::bigint * 1000 AND $__unixEpochTo()::bigint * 1000
  AND m.key LIKE 'delta/%'
ORDER BY 1

SELECT to_timestamp(m.timestamp / 1000.0) AS time,
       td.value || ' ' || replace(m.key, 'max_err/', '') AS series, m.value
FROM latest_metrics m
JOIN runs r ON r.run_uuid = m.run_uuid
JOIN experiments e ON e.experiment_id = r.experiment_id
JOIN tags td ON td.run_uuid = r.run_uuid AND td.key = 'device'
JOIN tags tb ON tb.run_uuid = r.run_uuid AND tb.key = 'branch'
WHERE e.name = 'kernel-bench' AND r.lifecycle_stage = 'active'
  AND td.value IN ($device) AND tb.value IN ($branch)
  AND m.timestamp BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()::bigint * 1000 AND $__unixEpochTo()::bigint * 1000
  AND m.key LIKE 'max_err/%'
ORDER BY 1

SELECT to_timestamp(r.start_time / 1000.0) AS "commit time",
       ts.value AS sha, td.value AS device, tb.value AS branch, r.status,
       max(CASE WHEN m.key = 'fused_ms/N196'  THEN m.value END) AS "N196 ms",
       max(CASE WHEN m.key = 'delta/N196'     THEN m.value END) AS "N196 Δ",
       max(CASE WHEN m.key = 'fused_ms/N3136' THEN m.value END) AS "N3136 ms",
       max(CASE WHEN m.key = 'delta/N3136'    THEN m.value END) AS "N3136 Δ",
       max(CASE WHEN m.key LIKE 'max_err/%'   THEN m.value END) AS "max err",
       tu.value AS run_url
FROM latest_metrics m
JOIN runs r ON r.run_uuid = m.run_uuid
JOIN experiments e ON e.experiment_id = r.experiment_id
JOIN tags td ON td.run_uuid = r.run_uuid AND td.key = 'device'
JOIN tags tb ON tb.run_uuid = r.run_uuid AND tb.key = 'branch'
JOIN tags ts ON ts.run_uuid = r.run_uuid AND ts.key = 'sha'
LEFT JOIN tags tu ON tu.run_uuid = r.run_uuid AND tu.key = 'run_url'
WHERE e.name = 'kernel-bench' AND r.lifecycle_stage = 'active'
  AND td.value IN ($device) AND tb.value IN ($branch)
  AND m.timestamp BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()::bigint * 1000 AND $__unixEpochTo()::bigint * 1000
GROUP BY r.run_uuid, r.start_time, ts.value, td.value, tb.value, r.status, tu.value
ORDER BY r.start_time DESC
LIMIT 50
